prompt:
REFERENCES
@image1 — Peter, 65: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — The woman, 41: face, hair and build only.
@image3 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image4 — the store aisle: copy it — paper shelves left, detergent shelves right, the blue end-cap at the far right corner, the walkway across the far end.
@audio1 — The woman's voice.

SHOT: An animated comedy-drama payoff: back in the store aisle the younger woman turns on Peter, then runs after Michelle to ask what she uses; one take of 6 shots, 9:16, 20 s.

TIMELINE
[0–3s] Shot 1 · medium, slow pan: Frame 1: Peter frozen at the end-cap behind his cart staring frame right; the woman at his shoulder looking at him; Michelle beyond them on the walkway, walking away — the woman's head snaps round to Peter; the pan settles on the two of them. The woman says: "Wait. That is your ex-wife?"
[3–6s] Shot 2 · full shot, leading her, backing away in front: the woman strides five quick steps and draws level with Michelle's cart. The woman says: "I am sorry, I just have to ask."
[6–9s] Shot 3 · medium close-up, locked: the woman leans toward Michelle, hand out; Michelle's shoulder turns in the foreground. The woman says: "What do you use on your skin? You look amazing."
[9–13s] Shot 4 · close-up, locked: her head turns, the smile grows slowly; she does not speak. A beat of stillness first.
[13–17s] Shot 5 · full shot, follows from behind: the cart turns and she walks five easy strides away; the camera follows behind.
[17–20s] Shot 6 · wide, the camera pulls back: his hand slips off the handle; the camera pulls back and up. Last frame: Peter alone at the end-cap behind his cart, small; Michelle gone.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from the long rows of overhead store light panels, a shadow side on every face. Peter: the navy quarter-zip over a white collared shirt, tan chinos, brown boat shoes; The woman: the camel cropped blazer over a white ribbed tank, black flared leggings, white platform trainers; Michelle: the soft cream boat-neck fine-knit sweater, high-waisted camel wide-leg trousers, tan leather loafers.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — The woman's voice from @audio1; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: the cart wheels, trainers hurrying on the shiny floor; the store's soft air-conditioning hum under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Peter and the woman and Michelle in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
